# discord_guild_template (Resource)

Manages a Discord guild template, a snapshot of a guild's settings that can be used to create new guilds.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "discord_guild_template" "base" {
  guild_id    = "123456789012345678"
  name        = "Community Base"
  description = "Starter layout for new community servers"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `guild_id` (String) Snowflake ID of the source guild. Changing this forces a new template.
- `name` (String) Template name (1-100 characters).

### Optional

- `description` (String) Template description (0-120 characters).

### Read-Only

- `code` (String) The unique template code (also the resource ID).
- `source_guild_id` (String) Snowflake ID of the guild the template is based on.
- `usage_count` (Number) Number of times the template has been used.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Templates are imported using "guild_id:code".
terraform import discord_guild_template.base 123456789012345678:abcd1234efgh
```
